hangup.description: End the current call. Use this when the caller clearly says goodbye or wants to finish the conversation.

transfer.description: Transfer the current call to another extension or phone number.

params.target: string — the extension or phone number to transfer the call to

hold.description: Put the caller on hold (pause the audio for the remote party).

unhold.description: Resume a call that is currently on hold.

sendDTMF.description: Send DTMF keypad tones into the call (for navigating IVR menus, entering codes, etc.).

params.dtmf: string — the digits to send, e.g. '123#'

wait.description: Pause silently for a period of time before doing anything else.

params.time: number — how long to wait, in milliseconds

dnd.description: Enable Do Not Disturb mode for this agent.
